artists.name: Arijit Singh
artists.bio: Widely regarded as the undisputed soulful voice of modern Indian cinema. Winner of two National Film Awards and numerous Filmfare accolades, famous for timeless romantic and emotional ballads.

artists.name: Shreya Ghoshal
artists.role: Queen of Melody & Classical Playback Singer
artists.bio: One of the most celebrated vocalists in Indian music history. With 5 National Film Awards, she has enchanted generations with pristine vocal control, classical mastery, and Bollywood mega-hits.

artists.name: Pawan Singh
artists.bio: The undisputed "Power Star" of Bhojpuri cinema and folk music. Renowned worldwide for the viral phenomenon "Lollypop Lagelu" and modern high-energy desi chartbusters.

artists.name: Khesari Lal Yadav
artists.bio: Bhojpuri cinema superstar and charismatic folk-pop icon with over a decade of consecutive mega-hits. His infectious rhythm, dance numbers, and lyrical charm dominate festivities across India.

artists.name: A. R. Rahman
artists.bio: The "Mozart of Madras" who revolutionized Indian film scores by fusing electronic synthesis, world instruments, Sufi spirituality, and symphonic orchestrations.

artists.name: Shilpi Raj
artists.bio: The fastest-rising female playback artist in Bhojpuri music, lending her powerhouse voice to hundreds of trending dance anthems and wedding hits across Northern India.

artists.name: Neha Kakkar
artists.bio: High-energy Bollywood playback star famed for viral party anthems, festive tracks, and emotional unplugged performances.

artists.name: Diljit Dosanjh
artists.bio: Global superstar who brought contemporary Punjabi and Indian music to Coachella and international stadiums with his modern swag and infectious groove.

artists.name: Yo Yo Honey Singh
artists.bio: Legendary Indian music producer, Desi hip-hop pioneer, and chart-topping rapper behind iconic blockbusters like Blue Eyes, Desi Kalakaar, Brown Rang, Love Dose, and Lungi Dance.

artists.name: Jubin Nautiyal
artists.bio: Acclaimed Indian playback vocalist celebrated for heartfelt romantic ballads like Raataan Lambiyan, Lut Gaye, and devotional masterpieces.

artists.name: Sonu Nigam
artists.bio: One of India’s most versatile and revered playback legends with timeless classics like Kal Ho Naa Ho, Abhi Mujh Mein Kahin, and Sandese Aate Hai.

artists.name: Badshah
artists.role: King of Bollywood Party Rap & Pop
artists.bio: Chart-dominating Indian rapper and hitmaker famous for high-voltage anthems like Kala Chashma, DJ Waley Babu, Genda Phool, and Jugnu.

artists.name: Udit Narayan
artists.bio: Iconic voice of 90s and 2000s Hindi cinema with evergreen superhits across romance, family dramas, and festive celebrations.

artists.name: Kumar Sanu
artists.bio: Guinness World Record-holding playback legend whose romantic hits defined an entire era of Bollywood music.

artists.name: Lata Mangeshkar
artists.bio: The immortal Nightingale of India whose divine voice recorded thousands of timeless songs across Hindi and regional Indian cinema.

artists.name: Kishore Kumar
artists.bio: Unmatched golden-era genius whose soulful melodies and energetic classics remain etched in the hearts of every music lover.

artists.name: Atif Aslam
artists.bio: Celebrated vocalist known for unforgettable romantic chartbusters like Dil Diyan Gallan, Tera Hone Laga Hoon, and Jeene Laga Hoon.

artists.name: B Praak
artists.bio: Powerhouse emotional singer and composer behind Teri Mitti, Ranjha, Mann Bharryaa, and Filhall.

artists.name: AP Dhillon
artists.bio: Global Punjabi sensation blending R&B, hip-hop, and synth-pop on hits like Excuses, Brown Munde, and With You.

artists.name: Karan Aujla
artists.bio: Modern Punjabi superstar behind viral global smashes Tauba Tauba, Softly, and Making Memories.

artists.name: Darshan Raval
artists.bio: Youth heartthrob famed for Chogada, Kamariya, Tera Zikr, and soulful monsoon ballads.

artists.name: Armaan Malik
artists.bio: Silky-voiced playback and global pop singer behind Bol Do Na Zara, Butta Bomma, and Jab Tak.

artists.name: Vishal Mishra
artists.bio: Chart-topping composer and vocalist celebrated for Kaise Hua, Pehle Bhi Main, and Janiye.

artists.name: Manoj Tiwari
artists.bio: Pioneer of modern Bhojpuri cinema and folk music known for Rinkiya Ke Papa, Chhath Puja classics, and Purvanchal folk hits.

artists.name: The Weeknd
artists.bio: Grammy-winning global music icon behind record-shattering English anthems like Blinding Lights, Starboy, Save Your Tears, and Die For You.

artists.name: Ed Sheeran
artists.bio: Multi-Grammy winning British singer-songwriter famed worldwide for Shape of You, Perfect, Photograph, and Bad Habits.

artists.name: Imagine Dragons
artists.role: Global Alternative Rock & Arena Anthem Band
artists.bio: World-renowned rock and pop band celebrated for explosive stadium anthems including Believer, Thunder, Radioactive, and Bones.

artists.name: Dua Lipa
artists.bio: Grammy and Brit Award-winning pop powerhouse behind global chartbusters Levitating, Don’t Start Now, Houdini, and New Rules.

artists.name: The Chainsmokers
artists.bio: Grammy-winning electronic DJ and production duo famous for diamond-certified English hits Closer, Something Just Like This, and Don’t Let Me Down.

artists.name: Hariharan
artists.bio: Legendary Padma Shri vocalist whose rendition of Shree Hanuman Chalisa and sacred bhajans has billions of streams worldwide.
